notes.title: Patch (10-10-2022)
notes.notes:
- Fixed a game-breaking progression bug in Chapter 5 where you can assemble all hikers, but the hike doesn't trigger
- Added a History panel feature to view previous lines of dialogue.

History Panel show/hide controls:
Keyboard: Shift
Mouse: Right click
Xbox Controller: Y / LB
PlayStation Controller: Triangle / L1
